description: Boundary coverage for record schema derivation on the single-field record shapes (record_single_boolean / record_single_int / record_single_string). The native suite only renders schemas for the eight-primitive, nested, and deep records, never for the single-field shapes (those are exercised only by record ENCODING). These cases assert each single-field record renders a canonical 'record' schema document carrying its own type name and one field 'z' whose type follows the primitive mapping.
